name: FormRelay Self-Hosted Form Backend
free_limit: MIT-licensed Next.js form submission backend with Supabase-backed forms, real-time response dashboard, per-form email notification integration, allowed-domain checks and built-in per-IP rate limiting. Free to run and modify indefinitely on infrastructure you provide; no software subscription quota is documented.
watch_out: Requires separately configured Supabase account/database and Resend account/API key for email notifications, plus your own Next.js runtime/hosting. Supabase, Resend and hosting free tiers have independent quotas and may incur costs; this project does not provide free hosted form submissions or infrastructure. Documentation primarily describes local development; verify production security, service-role key handling, database RLS and deployment before exposing publicly.
